adjudication.rationale: The diff changes the Meet fallback check in `packages/core/EventManager.ts` to destructure `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];` and then unconditionally accesses `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration`. When `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, `undefined`, or an empty array (which the diff now commonly sets to `[]` in multiple call sites), `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined` and this will throw a TypeError, causing a 500 instead of the previous safe optional-chaining behavior (`evt.destinationCalendar?.integration`).
